asset_ownership_interpretation: Goldfinch combines on-chain pool positions with borrower-specific off-chain legal agreements. Investor rights and recovery treatment therefore depend on the specific pool or product rather than fitting a single centralized-custody ownership model.
affected_product: Goldfinch borrower pools and Senior Pool
notes: Official documentation states that default parameters are reflected both in off-chain legal agreements and pool smart contracts. CYA therefore avoids assigning a universal ownership or recovery characterization across all Goldfinch positions.
